verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a dedicated 'Ironclad AI' product page positioned as 'contract intelligence,' and docs explicitly note that Workflow APIs can be used to run AI-driven analysis on contract data and 'surface these insights to your users.' However, the evidence is limited to marketing taglines and a single API doc snippet, with no detail on specific AI-generated insight features (e.g., risk scoring, clause analysis) or independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI capabilities in the product itself. Missing for 10: concrete first-party documentation of specific AI insight features (obligation tracking, risk flags, summarization), and independent/hands-on validation that AI insights actually surface in the UI.
